description: Follow notifications: a FOLLOW notification is created on every POST /profiles/:username/follow, including retries of an existing follow, so users get duplicate alerts.
notes: FM-04 (duplicates under at-least-once delivery). Prisma's `connect` makes the follow itself idempotent, but the new `notification.create` in followUser runs on every call, so a retried, double-clicked or replayed POST /profiles/:username/follow creates another FOLLOW notification for a follow that already existed (repeated alerts). Severity important: FM-04 grades important, and no money, goods or data are lost, so it doesn't reach critical. Fix: create the notification only when the follow is new (check followedBy before the update) or dedupe on (type, recipientId, actorId). Legit parts: schema, migration, notifications route scoped to the caller.
